program_plain: World: 400 point particles in a 20x20 periodic box (density 1), with no collisions. Rules: (1) each moves forward at constant speed 0.1 along its heading (small inertia); (2) it sees only particles within distance R = 5 inside a vision cone of half-angle pi/8 around its heading; (3) it turns toward the positions of the visible particles, turning rate 3 times the average sine of the angle between its heading and the bearing to each (no copying of their headings); (4) its heading gets rotational noise of strength 0.08. Seeing is one-sided: being seen does not imply seeing back. Run 200,000 steps of size 0.005.

THE RULE SYSTEM (plain words):
World: 400 point particles in a 20x20 periodic box (density 1), with no collisions. Rules: (1) each moves forward at constant speed 0.1 along its heading (small inertia); (2) it sees only particles within distance R = 5 inside a vision cone of half-angle pi/8 around its heading; (3) it turns toward the positions of the visible particles, turning rate 3 times the average sine of the angle between its heading and the bearing to each (no copying of their headings); (4) its heading gets rotational noise of strength 0.08. Seeing is one-sided: being seen does not imply seeing back. Run 200,000 steps of size 0.005.
